verdict.rationale: Superset advertises a local-first architecture ('your code never leaves your machine unless you say so') and offers remote/hosted workspace and MCP server features, so data-location/privacy posture is a fair question for this product. However, there is no evidence of any region-selection, residency configuration, or data-center choice for its hosted/remote components (e.g., api.superset.sh, remote workspaces) — only a binary local-vs-remote framing.
